title: tf.math.segment_max/min/mean/sum/prod crashes when segment_ids is large due to integer overflow
trigger_payload:
import tensorflow as tf
x = tf.constant([1.0, 2.0, 3.0])
segment_ids = tf.constant([2**31 - 1, 2**31 - 1, 2**31 - 1])
result = tf.math.segment_max(x, segment_ids)
oracle: the program crashes (aborts) due to integer overflow
